notes.title: Disc Golf City – Full Release is Here!
notes.notes:
It’s official – Disc Golf City has left Early Access!
We’re thrilled to share that after months of testing, feedback, and community support, Disc Golf City is now fully released!   

What’s new in the Full Release:  

• 🏙️ New courses and city locations to master  

• 🎯 Improved disc physics and shot mechanics  

• 🎮 Polished UI and smoother controls  

• 🏆 Steam Achievements & leaderboards  


A huge thank you to everyone who joined us during Early Access. Your feedback has been vital in shaping the game into what it is today.  


This is just the beginning! 

We’ll continue supporting Disc Golf City with updates, events, and new content down the road.  

So grab your disc, hit the fairways of the city, and aim for glory.  

See you on the streets! 🥏
